description.value: Your communities live in the steep cliffs and ravines of mountains, or in the depths of expansive caverns where you could fly in. As a result, you can navigate these tight spaces more easily. You become trained in Survival, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks while navigating, tracking or subsisting cavernous or mountainous terrain. While you are adjacent to a surface, ceiling or floor and take a Fly action, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Fly speed as you can leap or coast along it for a burst of speed.
